lead.headline: Mexico seizes 'El Chapo Isidro', one of the FBI's most wanted
lead.summary: Mexican troops captured Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as 'El Chapo Isidro', in a night raid in Sinaloa, along with two other leaders of his trafficking group. He was one of the FBI's ten most wanted fugitives, with a $5m reward on his head. Cartel gunmen answered with burning roadblocks.

stats.label: Crew evacuated from the Sparta II

stories.headline: COP31 nears a deal as talks run into Sunday
stories.summary: Negotiators worked past their Friday deadline into Sunday. A new package goes to nearly 200 nations for approval on Sunday morning, after an earlier draft dropped all mention of fossil fuels.

stories.headline: Russian ship ablaze in the Baltic after drone strike
stories.summary: The sanctioned cargo ship Sparta II was hit by drones in the Gulf of Finland on Saturday. Its 16 crew escaped to lifeboats, then to a Russian ship, as the fire burned on and Finland led the rescue.

stories.headline: Bahrain hit as Iran war widens
stories.summary: Bahrain said an Iranian attack set an industrial facility ablaze, while its air defences intercepted other strikes. Home to the US Navy's Fifth Fleet, it warned residents of a possible new threat.

stories.headline: FBI's crime database is breached
stories.summary: Hackers broke into the FBI's nationwide crime database, used by police across America to share warrants and background checks — the second FBI breach in months. President Trump played down the intrusion on Saturday.

stories.headline: Alcaraz faces Zverev in ATP final
stories.summary: Carlos Alcaraz fought back past Ben Shelton on Saturday to set up Sunday's final in Turin against world No. 1 Alexander Zverev, who seeks a third title; Alcaraz seeks his first.
